# cat.i64

An IDA 7 database of GNU `cat` (ELF x86-64), from python-idb's test data
(https://github.com/williballenthin/python-idb/tree/master/tests/data, Apache-2.0),
as vendored by idb-rs (`resources/idbs/cat.i64`). The unit tests of `crates/unlace-idb` and of
the `unlace idb` module (`crates/unlace-cli/src/idb/tests.rs`) read it.
